mentions.name: CapitalReach.ai
mentions.description: AI-powered fundraising platform for founders that automatically finds and matches them with the right investors, personalizes and automates outreach campaigns, tracks investor responses, and manages the entire fundraising pipeline in one place.
mentions.problem: Fundraising is painful and full of repetitive work; the tool removes repetitive tasks to make fundraising easier for founders.
mentions.audience: Uses AI to automate the repetitive parts of fundraising so founders can focus on building investor relationships.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We recently launched CapitalReach.ai  - https://capitalreach.ai 
We built it to make fundraising easier for founders, it uses AI to help you:

1. Find and match with the right investors automatically
2. Personalize and automate outreach campaigns
3. Track investor responses and manage your fundraising pipeline in one place
